mapper.sql: select id, order_no, user_id, course_id, content, create_time, update_time from course_review
mapper.select: select cr.id, cr.order_no, cr.user_id, cr.course_id, cr.content, cr.create_time, cr.update_time, coalesce(nullif(ui.user_name, ''), '微信用户') as reviewer_name, ui.avatar_url as reviewer_avatar_url from course_review cr left join user_info ui on ui.user_id = cr.user_id where cr.course_id = #{courseId} order by cr.update_time desc, cr.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into course_review (order_no, user_id, course_id, content, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
